item.title: Daronte Jones: NEW DC in D.C. + Super Bowl Preview | Command Center Podcast | Washington Commanders | NFL
item.description: The guys have special guest and Super Bowl Champion Brian Mitchell join the show to breakdown the upcoming Super Bowl 60 matchup between Drake Maye and the New England Patriots and Sam Darnold and the Seattle Seahawks. Plus, they give you all the details on the Commanders new DC Daronte Jones and what we can expect to see from him in Washington. Finally, it's a game of Washington Super Bowl trivia! item.description: The guys give share their heartfelt memories of the great Sonny Jurgensen. Then, they discuss Super Bowl 60, Sam Darnold's redemption story and Drake Maye's postseason collapse. Next, what's more important to win a championship: an elite QB or an elite defense? Plus, they breakdown how close Washington really is to a Super Bowl.
